name: Boris Granular
author: sd88me
summary: Real-time granular insert effect: incoming audio is written to a 10 s buffer and up to 24 overlapping grains replay it with per-grain random size, delay, pitch, direction, volume and pan. Tempo sync to MPC (1/16 to 4/1, dotted and triplet), freeze, feedback, dry/wet, three grain envelopes, 22 presets and a one-page touchscreen skin with two Q-Link sets. DSP from boris-move, a port of Boris Granular Station by Alessandro Gaiba.
